whatThisIs: Tours that PASSED the full liveness/bookability/affiliate/dedupe gate but have NO publishable adult fare. FareHarbor price-preview price.low is the CHEAPEST customer type (often a child or lap-infant rate), and the public API exposes customer type NAMES but never per-type PRICES. These rows are parked, not rejected.
howToResolve: Needs operator API keys to read per-customer-type rates. Do NOT publish priceBoundsCents.low as an adult fare, and do NOT substitute .high (same min/max trap). Do NOT POST the booking flow to price them - that creates phantom holds on live operators.
